text:
emily-marketing: Kicking off benchmark narrative thread. Need: single-sentence hero claim, 3 visual options, webinar angle, and lead-routing rules. Emphasis: dollars-per-token across latency tiers and clear CTA.

noah-growth: Hero tests: A) "Lower inference spend, keep latency tight" B) "Predictable performance, predictable spend". Use A for paid.

tessa-analytics: Ill prepare two datasets (chat vs bulk). Visuals: 1) heatmap (seq_len x req/sec, color=$/1k), 2) two-panel (latency curve | cost curve), 3) compact table + microcalc (1M tokens -> $).

omar-product: Add tech tooltip: "fallback to quantized variant adds ~5-15ms, reduces cost by 30-60%". We'll include as footnote.

kai-design: I can deliver quick mocks: navy/teal palette, microcalc badge, and an icon set for routing (self-serve / SDR / AE). Will post PNGs by tomorrow.

nina-sales: Form fields: monthly tokens, avg seq length, p95 SLO, company size. Routing: score>0.7 -> AE, 0.4-0.7 -> SDR, else nurture. Checkbox: "Request capacity review" to force AE.

emily-marketing: Webinar hook: "Serving LLMs: Real cost, real latency, real tradeoffs" Format: 20m story + 20m demo + 20m live Q. Panel: Omar + Tessa + 1 customer. Registration asks routing fields.

tessa-analytics: Will upload CSVs + README to #assets with column defs: seq_len, reqs_per_sec, cost_per_k, p50_ms, p95_ms by EOD.

o mar-product: I'll draft tech copy for the landing page and a short FAQ on caching/quantization.

emily-marketing: Great. Kai, once mocks posted we'll pick primary visual and draft copy. Nina, prepare follow-up email template for AE outreach. Thanks all.
